quote: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as reasoning engines capable of intelligent reasoning and planning over complex tasks. Recent works have explored leveraging LLMs as intelligent agents, using natural language as an interface for taking actions and observing results.
outputs: LIDDIA generates small molecules in response to natural language prompts specifying target proteins and desired molecular properties.

quote: LIDDIA performs in silico assessments over molecules using its EVALUATOR.
